item.content:encoded: The object is okay, but I upvoted mainly for what I consider the real hook at the end, i.e., the Foundaton authorities are considering plugging other SCPs into this this thing, which is not a good idea and a violation of SOP, which says to me that this thing has affected the research staff and convinced them to gamble despite knowing the shouldn't. That's a horrible thought right there because that means it's only going to get worse. Reminds me of the Ritual Obsidion Knife. A fairly cool object with the implication that it has infected the Foundation itself. Any time the Foundation believably becomes the subject of an anomalous effect, it's browntrousers time.

item.content:encoded:
Oddly enough, the first version of this that I submitted had a "rip your flesh off to keep playing" effect instead of the current stage 3 effect. Frankly, it sucked, and the downvotes & deletion of the original version corroborate that opinion.

Going the obvious route with an object's effects is dull as hell, especially if that route is something involving spontaneous insanity and/or body horror self-mutilation. We have hundreds of body horror and crazy-to-death articles on the site- both have been done ad nauseum, and written better than I could hope to at that. So while I'll gladly admit that this is only a mediocre SCP, it does something unique and (I hope) a little interesting. If our voting system means anything, it's objectively better this way.
